rationale: The assistant correctly identified Auto mode's floor and dust sensing as normal behaviour, suggested the Eco comparison test, and gave no part recommendation or unnecessary escalation. It never asked which mode was shown or which head was fitted, instead assuming Auto mode. Its first reply also described the High Torque head, although the customer uses the Digital Motorbar. The closing reply slightly overstated the logic ('If the motor were faulty, switching to Eco wouldn't make the surging stop'), but the conclusion is right and safe.
